per_view.notes: Slender grey tube with front-third low hump and dash window band. Only one boxy engine block visible, hung from a flat edge-on wing slab with no dihedral. Vertical fin is an unswept rectangle; no horizontal stabilizers. Tail end is blunt, no tail cone. Nose wheel plus clustered mid wheels. Monochrome grey throughout.

Side profile shows one nacelle under a flat dark wing slab where two should be visible; no pylons. Front-third upper-deck hump with second window row present. Long slender tube but blunt uncapped tail, no tail cone. Vertical fin is an unswept rectangle; horizontal stabilizers absent. Nose gear plus clustered small wheels on thin struts.

Slender tube with flat blunt disc nose, no taper. Crude short upper hump with window dots, abrupt end. Flat slab wings, swept but untapered, no dihedral. Three nacelle cylinders visible under wings, loosely attached. Tall rectangular unswept fin; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Tiny nose strut only. Uniform grey scheme; square window dots along deck.

No engine nacelles or pylons anywhere under the flat slab wings. Slender grey tube ends in a blunt open cylinder cap, no tail cone. Front hump with windows and dark cockpit reads well. Vertical fin is a plain slab; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Tiny thin-strut wheels under belly. Window row present; coherent grey scheme.

Slender grey tube with blunt flat ends, partial raised upper section at front, evenly spaced window dashes. Wing is a flat dark slab, no dihedral or taper; only two clear nacelles plus a boxy block underneath. Rectangular unswept fin, no distinct horizontal stabilizers. Nose strut plus two mid struts with tiny detached wheels. Monochrome grey.

Nose is a flat blunt disk with a dark ring, no ogive taper. Hump is a partial-length pod with upper-deck windows, blended aft. Wings are paper-thin flat slabs, minimal sweep/dihedral. Only three nacelles visible (one left, two right) on short pylons. Fin is an unswept rectangular slab; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Gear trucks tiny. Monochrome grey scheme.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Empennage (tall vertical stabilizer + horizontal stabilizers)' (mean 3/10). Target the 8 anchor: single tall swept vertical stabilizer plus swept horizontal stabilizers at the tail cone, plausible sizes; then the 10 anchor: correct 747 empennage: very tall swept fin, low-mounted swept tailplane pair with dihedral, all tapered and proportioned to the fuselage.
